svg.title: Two equally likely meiotic orientations
svg.desc: Source12 F1 YyRr, red Y/R and blue y/r. Two n=2 homolog pairs. Unreplicated F1:4 chromosomes4 chromatids. MetaphaseI and anaphaseI:4 chromosomes8 chromatids. Sisters remain paired in meiosisI. Source: lect02b-genes_dogma original ODP. Original schematic, not to scale.
